notes.title: Mastering Combat in LotRT
notes.content: [h3]Hello, knights![/h3][p]Whether you’re fighting other chivalrous knights, a cunning hag or a terrifying dragon, combat superiority in Legends of the Round Table is rarely just about raw strength. We designed the game’s combat systems to reward observation, strategy, timing and a clever use of cards and abilities. Here are some strategies to keep you a step ahead of your foes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/477b7b87e855c025193a5111e8e4a8a14c4cf932.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Know Your Enemy[/h3][p]When the combat starts, take a moment to study your opponents! Some enemies have special rules and conditions. For example, “Felon” enemies will not abide by the rules of chivalry, “Unshakeable” enemies can’t be destabilized, etc.[/p][p]What armor is your opponent wearing? Does this dragon have any broken scales you could target? Is this felon already bleeding from the arm, another hit there might finish him off![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/15859fd7280e3a1a56f17222bfa867c6689ed9ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Movement in Combat[/h3][p]In fencing combat, a trained defender instinctively steps back when attacked to reduce the impact of the blow, ending up one space behind their original position. The attacker then occupies the vacated space. However, mounted opponents and instinctive fighters like wolves, giant rats or other animals will hold their ground instead.[/p][p]When you charge a knight or a creature on foot, your horse’s speed causes you to end up behind them after the attack! However, if your target is another charging knight, it triggers a counter-charge. In a counter-charge, both knights attack! The higher total wins, deals the damage and ends up behind the loser.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/ec2ec0430fa74b8098e7fa54b97892258258c77e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]Different Strikes[/h3][p]– There are a few kinds of strikes:[/p][p]– Slash: swords, axes, claws and other blades.[/p][p]– Thrust: lances, tips of your swords, fangs, etc.[/p][p]– Concussion: maces, mostly![/p][p]Special types: a wyvern’s acidic spit, for example![/p][p]Matching your strike to the enemy’s armor type will make all the difference.[/p][p][/p][h3]Aimed Attacks[/h3][p]When attacking an opponent, you can choose to aim for a specific body part, taking a penalty to your total in exchange for the chance to exploit a weakness or injury. This is especially useful if your enemy’s armor is damaged or missing in that area. When an attacker and defender play the same card season and the defender fails, the outermost layer of their armor (or a dragon’s scales!) will break, creating an exploitable weakness![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/a7b5eb5bc4954a03c4dfae8d7b0b7cb571324953.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Armor Layers[/h3][p]In the game rules, armor always has three layers. For example, knights wear gambeson, mail and plate, while a dragon might have no armor in the first two layers but a strong third layer of scales. Some creatures may have gaps entirely.[/p][p][/p][h3]More Tips![/h3][p]– Spending inspiration points to lower your own total can help you trigger a special defense in the body parts wheel that pops up when you’re defending from an attack.[/p][p]– If you have a high enough total to succeed a challenge without adding any card, you could still play one of your weaker cards to draw a new, potentially better one![/p][p]– You can create spells just to get rid of unwanted cards and draw new ones - potentially getting a useful spell in the process![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/330c702275b47839009c6992ab45e7893bc3ca93.jpg"][/img][/p][p][url="https://roundtablegame.com/discord" style="button"]Join the Discord server[/url] | [url="https://linktr.ee/artificestudio" style="button" buttoncolor="#fb3737"]Follow us on social media[/url][/p][p][/p][p]The game is chock-full or interesting systems and features that were all based on medieval chivalry and combat. When you get your hands on the demo (or the full game!) be sure to go over the player’s manual and familiarize yourself with the different rules.[/p][p]Until next time![/p][p]The Artifice Studio Team[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Auto-Combat, Optimizations & More! Demo Build v.18648855
notes.content:
Good day, brave knights!

We've been collecting your feedback since the launch of the demo and have been working on improving not only the demo itself, but the final game too.

We've very thankful to everyone that took the time to leave a review and share their comments with us on the [url=https://roundtablegame.com/discord]Discord server[/url].

Here are the main improvements we've made:

[h1]Auto-Combat[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've designed an auto-combat system that allows players to delegate tactical decisions to their lieutenants and quickly resolve combats during the Great Battles.
Auto-combat can't be used in combats with Arthur, or when you're attacking the enemy general.
[/list]

[h1]User Interface (UI) improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've improved the UI during persuation challenges by improving the visibility of cards and their associated modifiers.
[*] We've also clarified the tooltip for Group Cohesion, better describing its effects.
[/list]
[h1]Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Global performance upgrades - we've optimized multiple game systems, helping with game performance accross the board.
[*] Balanced Nero's stats and behavior during combat.
[*] Added swords for characters in the intro and conclusion of the London Tournament adventure.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a saving issue in the Green Knight adventure that was causing the introduction to replay after loading an adventure in progress.
[/list]

Please keep the feedback coming - it's super useful and we're working around the clock to improve the demo and the game thanks to your comments!

[h1]💬 Discord & Feedback[/h1]
We'd LOVE to know what you think of the demo - please join us on our [url=http://roundtablegame.com/discord]Discord server[/url] (http://roundtablegame.com/discord) and share your thoughts with us!

[h1]💚 Wishlist[/h1]
Please remember to wishlist the game (or demo - same thing!) it helps us tremendously. If you have a friend or a community that would love Legends of the Round Table, consider sending them a link to the free demo!

[h1]👑 Arthurian Adventures[/h1]
In Legends of the Round Table, you’ll take charge of King Arthur’s knights and shape the kingdom's fate through legendary quests filled with mystery, danger, and, of course, romance! These aren’t just any adventures, as they are drawn from real Arthurian tales and adapted to bring the folklore to life like never before. Inspired by Thomas Malory, Chrétien de Troyes and other medieval sources, every detail is crafted with care, from hand-painted art in the style of illuminated manuscripts to a soundtrack performed on real medieval instruments. It’s a rich blend of deep RPG storytelling, chivalric combat and love for the setting, and we can’t wait for you to experience it!

notes.title: The Green Knight, The Medieval Fair & The Demo
notes.content:
Greetings adventurers!

Earlier this May, we had the pleasure of meeting some of you at the Medieval Passion Fair here in Quebec and met quite a few future players 😀 We setup a PC so the visitors could try out the game and it was a resounding success!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/b255e3bb04d8fca7fc7a16332c86d3ff13eaa353.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Green Knight[/h1]

We're ready to tell you a little more about another of our adventures, which is inspired by the poem Sir Gawain and the Green Knight by the anonymous poet known as Pearl.

In The Green Knight, a mysterious man covered in greenery comes to King Arthur's court to challenge one of the Knights of the Round Table to strike him. Normally it's Gawain who rises to the challenge and beheads him. The Green Knight picks up his head and proclaims that whoever accepted the challenge must receive the same blow from him, in a year and a day at the Green Chapel, in Wales.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/cef9135fc2fb3681f3276766a89230faa695f1bc.jpg[/img]

Following the storyline of the original tale required adaptations to make it interactive and enjoyable to play. The symbols and layers of meaning, typical of tales and texts with a mythical background, have been preserved but also adapted to deepen certain aspects, provide explanations to the player, and achieve better coherence between gameplay actions and narration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/6e82ca1b5c8051b43edd0b8aef8f53aff31fb1d1.jpg[/img]

This adventure combines dreamlike sequences with moments of investigation and courtesy, as well as battles with monstrous creatures. And as you can see, it takes place in snowy landscapes...

We also greatly appreciated David Lowery's film The Green Knight with Dev Patel in the role of Gawain!

[h1]The Demo[/h1]
We have a playable demo coming soon and are looking for players for our very first playtests! If you're interested, join our [url=https://www.roundtablegame.com/discord]Discord server[/url] and pick the "playtest" role. 

Thanks everyone and until next time!

notes.title: Welcome to Legends of the Round Table! 👋 Here's what you missed. 😉
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, valiant knights and ladies![/h2]

We're very happy to finally have announced our game, Legends of the Round Table and to start building this incredible community that will hopefully be full of vibrant folks of all types! Fans of medieval History, roleplaying games, Arthurian folklore, beautiful art and music or just people that like to swing swords and ride fast horses! 😄

If you haven't yet, please remember to wishlist Legends of the Round Table (LotRT) on Steam! This makes the Magical Steam Algorithm like us and show the game to more people, more friends, woohoo! 👏

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2387040/Legends_of_the_Round_Table/

[h1]Sneak peeks[/h1]
LotRT is a game with a ton of intriguing stories, exciting adventures and incredible art to enjoy. We've already been dropping small teasers of what's to come before putting up the Steam page, so we figured we'd make a post here to show you what you missed so far!

[h2]Inspirations[/h2]
Sometimes, we like to go to real life medieval fairs and watch real riders jousting, 13th century style!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/03d39767053184ae4e6002b097e6a828a24a90bc.gif[/img]

If you'd like to dive into the games that inspired us (tabletop and videogames both), check out our [url=https://us9.campaign-archive.com/?u=f8b5d52a87f9eb9631f6f16f8&id=94e91b8310]fifth newsletter: The Games that Inspired Us![/url]

P.S.: Have you signed up to our newsletter yet? You should! [url=https://mailchi.mp/artificestudio/lotrt-newsletter]Click here to do so[/url]!

[h2]Gameplay Previews[/h2]
There's quite a few knights you'll be able to recruit to the Round Table, we showcase them every now and then. Here's one of our favorites, Sir Gawain. You can read more about him in our [url=https://mailchi.mp/artificestudio/lotrt-newsletter4]4th newsletter that dives deeper into some gameplay mechanics[/url].
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44791190/a68c6f305e782e479348085eaa8c5662456cba35.gif[/img]

[h2]Art & Music[/h2]
Some of LotRT's most unique aspects are the beautiful, hand-painted illuminated manuscript art and the music played on real, period-accurate instruments! 

Our recent newsletter, [url=https://us9.campaign-archive.com/?u=f8b5d52a87f9eb9631f6f16f8&id=2108789f21]Medieval Music for Videogames[/url], written with the help of Anne Azema from the Boston Camerata, goes over the unique challenges of creating the OST for the game!

We also occasionally publish musical extracts directly from the game to give you a taste of the excellent songs and music you'll enjoy during your adventures.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ydj6iBtJOlU
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xwfF8-ALRH4

When it comes to the art, the game's stunning visuals draw inspiration from illuminated manuscripts of the XIIIth century. Our artist has meticulously hand-drawn the environments, staying true to authentic medieval painting techniques, including the tools, dyes, and colors available during that period.

Here's a short sneak peek at the care and love that goes behind painting the elements of the game.
https://youtu.be/Vtrlc17Z1W0

[hr][/hr]

We hope you enjoy your time here and be sure to say hello! Leave a comment, join the [url=https://roundtablegame.com/discord]Legends of the Round Table Discord server[/url], check us out on [url=https://www.youtube.com/@ArtificeStudioGames]Youtube[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/artificestudio]X (Twitter)[/url], [url=https://www.facebook.com/artificestudio]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/artificestudiogames/]Instagram[/url] and most importantly, stay honorable!

See you soon.
